note: Contexts are research settings for desk analysis. Inclusion does not mean HPI operates there, has a partner there, or has assessed any individual. Fieldwork is NO-GO in every context.

items.name: Global (published international estimates)
items.summary: International estimates published by the World Bank and UNDP, used only as descriptive context. They are not comparable with local programme statistics.

items.name: Great Britain
items.summary: National DWP take-up estimates provide context for Newham but use a different method, unit and period from the local model.

items.name: Newham, London, United Kingdom
items.summary: Bounded public-source validation of Pension Credit receipt among low-income pension-age residents. The DWP 2023/24 local model is source-verified; no HPI study, participant or partner exists.

items.name: Brazil
items.summary: Federal programme rules for CadÚnico registration and Bolsa Família selection apply nationally; the Brazilian social electricity tariff study (E24) is national evidence, not Recife-specific.

items.name: Recife, Pernambuco, Brazil
items.summary: Contextual comparator for registration and administrative barriers in CadÚnico and Bolsa Família. No local eligible-but-not-receiving gap has been measured; identified research data require a qualifying research institution under LGPD.

items.name: Italy
items.summary: INPS publishes national Assegno di Inclusione caseload statistics; these do not estimate any city's take-up.

items.name: Campania, Italy
items.summary: Regional household relative poverty published from ISTAT 2025 statistics; region-level only.

items.name: Naples metropolitan area, Campania, Italy
items.summary: Reserve comparator for households potentially eligible for Assegno di Inclusione. Local eligible denominator, take-up and service additionality are unknown.

programmes.name: Pension Credit (UK)

pathway.description: Pension-age household meets income and other conditions (modelled by DWP at local-authority level).
A claim is made to DWP (online, telephone or with assistance).
DWP assesses and awards the claim.
Payments are received; DWP models households in receipt.
Any durable change in household security; not measured by any HPI source.

programmes.eligibilityNote: Modelled potential eligibility is not verified individual entitlement.

programmes.name: CadÚnico registration and Bolsa Família (Brazil)
programmes.administeredBy: Federal Ministry (MDS) with municipal CRAS registration services

pathway.description: Household per-capita income at or below the published threshold can be considered.
Household registers or updates its CadÚnico record at a municipal CRAS.
Federal assessment selects households; entry is not automatic and depends on assessment and budget.
Any durable change in household security; not measured by any HPI source.

programmes.eligibilityNote: Meeting the income threshold makes a family eligible to be considered, not entitled to automatic entry.

programmes.name: Assegno di Inclusione (Italy)

pathway.description: Household meets composition, means and other conditions.
Application submitted to INPS, directly or through intermediaries such as patronati.
Monthly payments are received; INPS publishes national caseload statistics.
Any durable change in household security; not measured by any HPI source.

programmes.eligibilityNote: Low household income alone does not establish ADI eligibility.
